artworks.title: San Giorgio dei Greci, Seen from an Arcade
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink and pen and gray ink over graphite, with watercolor and gouache, touched with gum arabic, on medium wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a view through an archway, with columns framing a canal and a bridge. People in period clothing are scattered along the canal, and a man is rowing a boat. Historic buildings line the canal, and a bell tower with a dome and cross is visible in the distance. The sky is clear with wisps of clouds. The color palette includes browns, grays, pinks, blues, and vibrant blue water. Brushstrokes convey movement and energy.

artworks.title: Two Architectural Studies
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink and brown wash over black chalk
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Dian Woodner
artworks.description: This is a drawing of architectural sketches. The drawing features two sections of intricate architectural designs. Both sketches are drawn in a vertical format showcasing baroque or classical elements, such as arches, columns, and elaborate ornamental details. The outline is delicate and detailed. The minimalistic background accentuates the lines of the architecture, highlighting the embellishments within each frame. The drawing captures the intricate design and structural elegance characteristic of classical architecture.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Girl
artworks.medium: daguerreotype
artworks.description: The image shows a young girl's seated upper body with her hands resting in her lap. Her face is turned slightly towards the camera, revealing straight hair parted in the middle that falls past her shoulders. She is wearing a dark, striped dress with short sleeves, secured with a sash around her waist. A ribbon or string is tied in her hair on both sides. The portrait is encased in an ornate gold-colored frame with a textured border. The background is a plain, neutral tone.

artworks.title: Carpenter
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures on a raised platform. The figure on the left is slightly bent forward with a raised arm holding sticks or batons. The figure on the right is leaning back, holding a cane. Clean lines and cross-hatching create depth and texture in their clothing and shadows.

artworks.title: Blind Man and a Woman
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals and a small dog. On the left, one person is standing and leaning forward with a walking stick. They wear a wide-brimmed hat, a coat, trousers, and shoes. A dog sits next to them. On the right, another person is seated, facing towards the standing person, with one hand on their draped legs. They wear a headscarf and robe. The background is plain with minimal detail, suggesting an outdoor setting.

artworks.title: The Vision of Ezekiel
artworks.medium: etching with engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 37.8 × 51.6 cm (14 7/8 × 20 5/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene featuring a biblical or mythical theme. The central figure is a robed character with outstretched arms. Many skeletal figures are rising from the ground or emerging from tombs in various poses. Above, a divine figure surrounded by angelic beings is looking down upon the scene. In the background, there are ancient ruinous structures on a hilltop. The sky is filled with dynamic cloud formations. The drawing is detailed with intricate line work.

artworks.title: Elegant Young Woman Seen from Behind
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper, proof
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Ann and Matthew Nimetz
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman shown from behind from the waist up. She is depicted standing and appears to be in a slightly turned position, with her left arm raised, holding an object that resembles a fan. Her facial features are not visible due to the angle, but her hair is styled in a short updo. She is wearing a light-colored garment with a textured and layered design at the back. Around her neck, she has a dark choker. The background is a softly textured and uniformly toned surface without distinct features.

artworks.title: Woods in the Park near Monza
artworks.medium: etching, softground etching, and aquatint on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Ann and Matthew Nimetz
artworks.description: The image features a dense woodland area with an arrangement of trees. The horizon is not visible, as the focus is on the trees and foliage. The composition shows a network of trunks and branches, with a central tree trunk standing prominently. The style of the brushstrokes is textured and sketch-like, depicting detail and movement in the bark and foliage. The color palette is monochrome, with varying shades of black, white, and grey creating contrast between the tree trunks and the background.

artworks.title: Intérieur d'église à Milan [Interior of a Church in Milan]
artworks.medium: etching with drypoint and aquatint on chine collé
artworks.description: The black and white etching shows six women seated on wooden chairs. They have indistinct facial features and wear ornate clothing with headdresses or shawls. The background features architectural details like arches and railing, drapery, and a hanging decoration or light fixture overhead. The floor is tiled.

artworks.title: The Artist's Wife in Profile Facing Right
artworks.medium: etching wtih bitten tone on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows an etching of a woman in a head-and-shoulders profile view. She faces right with a slightly downward head tilt. The etching captures her delicate facial features and a pensive expression. She wears a bonnet with intricate designs, has long hair, and an earring on her left ear. Her layered clothing has visible textures and folds. Her hands hold an object in front of her, obscured in the image. The background is shaded with crosshatching, transitioning from dark to light behind her profile.

artworks.title: Wooded Landscape with a Cart
artworks.medium: etching with sulphur tint (?), printed in brown and touched with graphite [proof]
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Ann and Matthew Nimetz
artworks.description: The image shows a pathway flanked by tall trees on both sides. The trees create a framing effect that guides the eye towards a vanishing point in the distance where the pathway meets the horizon. The horizon is positioned low in the composition, with the brushstrokes appearing soft and textured. The color palette consists of shades of sepia and brown, creating a warm yet subdued visual impact. The scene evokes a sense of early twilight or the muted light of dawn or dusk. Close to us, the textured forms of the trees and the pathway are evident, while in the distance, the scene fades into indistinctness at the horizon.

artworks.title: The Contemplative Life (Vita contemplativa)
artworks.medium: etching on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Ann and Matthew Nimetz
artworks.description: The image displays bold and jagged lines, with shadowy forms creating an abstract background. The silhouette of a human figure emerges from the center, casting its shadow over plant-like shapes. To the left and right, abstract shapes evoke images of birds perched on branches. A skeletal animal skull is discernible below, resembling features of a horse, amidst foliage.

artworks.title: Ila e le ninfe (Hylas and the Nymphs)
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut in teal and black on wove paper
artworks.description: The image has curved lines and shapes against a textured background. The artwork shows overlapping, sinuous forms resembling human bodies with a sense of movement and depth. The flowing lines give a sense of fluidity, and each form is defined by fine lines indicating musculature and contours similar to human anatomy.

artworks.title: lo levò in aria gridando, ecco il pane della providenza (I Held It Aloft and Cried, "Behold the Bread of Divine Providence!")
artworks.medium: lithograph on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a tavern or inn interior. It depicts a scene where various individuals are gathered around tables, with a prominent group seated at a central table. The atmosphere is rustic and warm, illuminated by a hanging lamp and small candles on the tables. The setting appears to be medieval or early modern based on the attire of the figures. The architecture features wooden beam ceilings and archways. A dog is seen near the foreground, while the background shows shelves with dishes and a cabinet. The drawing captures the social interactions and ambiance of the period.

artworks.title: "...disposto...disposto sempre all'ubbidienza" (Always Ready to Obey)
artworks.medium: lithograph on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three figures outside a stone chapel. The scene includes a natural landscape with trees and rocky hills. The figures are richly dressed in period costumes and seem to be engaged in a dramatic interaction.

artworks.title: Vedetta [Il gentiluomo] (The Lookout [The Gentleman])
artworks.medium: etching with plate tone on wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a person standing near the corner of a room, leaning against the wall. The individual is standing upright with one leg slightly bent. They have a beard, long hair, and are wearing period attire, including a wide-brimmed hat with a feather, a long coat, tunic, cravat, breeches, and stockings. The person holds an object, possibly a cane. The background shows detailed linework on the walls and a simple floor.

artworks.title: Ruins of the House of Septimius Severus on the Palatine (Rovine della casa di S.S. sul Palatino )
artworks.medium: etching
artworks.description: The image shows ancient ruins and dense foliage from a lower vantage point. A rocky and vegetated ridge occupies the right side, with a statue on top. Archways in the ruins create depth, leading the eye further into the scene. The painting features intricate brushstrokes detailing rock surfaces and vegetation. The color palette is monochrome, using shades of black and white for contrast. Dark plants and stone structures dominate the foreground, while light filters through an archway in the distance.

artworks.title: Aux Iles Borromeo [Lago maggiore] (On the Borromean Islands [Lago Maggiore])
artworks.medium: etching on buff laid paper
artworks.description: The image features an etching of a landscape with trees and an architectural ruin. In the foreground, there is a tower-like structure with adjacent arches, surrounded by trees with overhanging branches. Distant mountains are visible on the horizon. The artwork is detailed with fine lines and cross-hatching, creating texture and depth. The color scheme is monochromatic in shades of black and white. A figure can be seen walking along a path in the foreground.

artworks.title: Selva (Woods)
artworks.medium: etching on chine collé
artworks.description: The image shows a low perspective view looking upward into a dense wooded area. The scene features closely packed trees and foliage, with a path or clearing leading into the woods. The artwork uses fine lines and cross-hatching to depict textures and shadows, in a monochromatic color scheme of black and white. In the background, a partially visible sky with soft textures hints at clouds above the trees.

artworks.title: In Montagna (In the Mountains)
artworks.medium: etching on chine collé [proof]
artworks.description: The image depicts a ground-level view of a landscape with tall, slender trees at the center. The trees have wide branches creating a network of lines and shadows. The horizon is low, suggesting vast land beyond the trees. Two people are walking along a path in the distance, giving scale and depth to the composition. The etching features detailed brushstrokes emphasizing texture of the ground and leaves. The color scheme is monochromatic with varying shades of black and gray, enhancing contrasts and details against the light background. Overall, the scene conveys a serene and quietly dramatic atmosphere, inviting contemplation of the natural beauty and tranquility of the landscape.

artworks.title: Carle Van Loo
artworks.artist: Gilles Demarteau, the Elder, after Carle Van Loo
artworks.medium: chalk manner printed in red on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 46.5 × 32.9 cm (18 5/16 × 12 15/16 in.), cut to platemark
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. Ivan E. and Winifred Phillips
artworks.description: The image depicts a man from the waist up, leaning forward with his right arm resting on a ledge and his left hand holding a cane. He faces the left side, showing his profile. He has a prominent nose, high cheekbones, and short, subtly curled hair. He wears a coat with a decorative pattern over a vest and a scarf. The background is a simple, textured surface.

artworks.title: Arabe veillant le corps de son ami (Arab Watching over the Body of His Friend)
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint on buff laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Jimmy and Jessica Younger, Houston
artworks.description: The image shows one person sitting cross-legged on the floor next to another individual laying down supine. The seated person has a muscular build, a headpiece, and minimal clothing covering the lower body. The surroundings include a clay jar against a plain wall, with a dim and textured background.

artworks.title: Dead Kabyle (Kabyle mort)
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint on buff laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Jimmy and Jessica Younger, Houston
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a figure lying motionless under a draped sheet with a candle nearby. The scene appears somber, depicting a lifeless form covered with a cloth, illuminated by a candle. Shadows and cross-hatching techniques are used extensively, creating a dramatic atmosphere. The minimalist background emphasizes the focus on the central subject and the candle.

artworks.title: Il corpo di Luciano Manara visitato dai soldari (The Body of Luciano Manara Visited by Soldiers)
artworks.medium: etching on heavy laid paper
artworks.description: This is an interior scene featuring a draped body on a bier. The setting includes plain walls, a closed door in the background, and a cross hanging on the wall to the left. The body is covered with a sheet on a table-like structure. Objects in the room include bottles on the floor. Figures stand to the right, observing the body. The text "ROMA - 1849" is inscribed at the top, and "IL CORPO DI LUCIANO MANARA VISITATO DAI SOLDATI" is written at the bottom. The composition shows fine lines depicting textures and shadows, typical of etching.
